title: paraphlomis albiflora var. biflora
intro: Paraphlomis albiflora var. biflora, commonly known as White-flowered Paraphlomis, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of White-flowered Paraphlomis include expectorant, anti-tussive, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can aid in the relief of respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Paraphlomis albiflora var. biflora include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
